featured_reviews.review_text:
I am extremely grateful to Dr. Pooja Madhav, her clinic, and the entire hospital team for the exceptional care and support throughout my pregnancy and delivery.
I had a breech baby, and most doctors advised a C-section. However, Dr. Pooja Madhav carefully evaluated my condition and, with her vast experience, confidence, and continuous monitoring, she successfully helped me deliver naturally. This truly reflects her expertise and dedication.
Additionally, I had a 10 cm fibroid near my cervix, and Dr. Pooja Madhav performed surgery in the 4th month of pregnancy. The surgery was handled with great precision and care, and it resulted in a successful outcome. Because of her timely decisions and excellent treatment, my pregnancy progressed smoothly afterward.
The clinic and hospital staff were also extremely polite, helpful, and cooperative. From nurses to support staff, everyone was caring, respectful, and always ready to assist, which made the entire journey comfortable and stress-free.
Thanks to Dr. Pooja Madhav and her wonderful team, I safely delivered a healthy baby boy. She is knowledgeable, compassionate, and always explains everything clearly, giving immense confidence and peace of mind.
I highly recommend Dr. Pooja Madhav and her clinic to all expecting mothers. Truly a blessing to be under such excellent care🙏💙
